solutions.title: Expand from every start
solutions.strategy: For each start index, extend right until all required counts are covered, then record the shortest candidate.

timeComplexity.explanation: A fresh rightward scan can run for each start position.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Counters store up to k distinct required/window characters.

solutions.title: Sliding window with formed count
solutions.strategy: Expand right to satisfy missing counts, then contract left while preserving validity to minimize the window.

timeComplexity.explanation: The source and target strings are scanned linearly with two pointers.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Counters store distinct target and active window characters.
